lines.en: Oh, my God. Okay, you guys, here's Danny. Watch.
See? Still pretending he's not interested.
Okay, he's coming over. Just pretend like we don't know him.
She's nice. She's not bad to look at, right?
Do you want to go out on a date with her, Monica?
Friday is perfect. She can't wait.
On the date, I would be able to talk to her directly, right?
Okay, what the hell was that?
You know what? Don't answer me.
I have a date with Danny.
